_comment: Chip Explorer dies (explorer_geom.py). Each die is exported from the recipe its die runs use. 'commit' pins the source; otherwise the recipe commit is the last commit under 'paths' reachable from 'ref' (fallbacks in 'ref_fallback'), and the cache is re-exported when it changes. 'reach_um' is the die's one-cycle wire reach, used for the geometric link budget on element cards.
